origin: Codex 0.142.5: the view_image tool answers with an image as the output of the call; the conversion to Chat has no place for the image, so a relay is given "[no output]" for it where the native accounts of the route read text only (a Claude model) and is left out of the request where they would have been given the image (a gpt model). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
